name: ENAV S.p.A.
summary: ENAV S.p.A. provides air traffic control and management, and other air navigation services in Italy, the rest of Europe, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Air Navigation Services, Maintenance Services, and Aeronautical Information Management (AIM) Software Solutions. The company offers technical management and maintenance services for air traffic control equipment and systems, as well as for air infrastructure. It also develops software solutions for the management of aeronautical information and air traffic; and provides associated commercial and maintenance services.
